item.title: "Flohmarktfunde" has moved
item.author: mail@christianmahnke.de (Christian Mahnke)
item.description:
“Flohmarktfunde” has moved and is now part of Projektemacher.org . This is the second of my old Tumblr blogs to be converted to Hugo .

The old Tumblr page remains in place, as there may still be some links pointing to it…
